data.one_liner: A widget that makes itself transparent to hit testing while letting its subtree receive pointer events.
data.what_it_does: TransparentPointer allows you to control hit testing so that a widget is invisible to pointer events for its parent, yet still allows its own subtree to receive them. This enables overlapping widgets to simultaneously capture gestures.
use_when: You need a gesture detector behind another widget to still receive drag or tap events.
You want a widget to pass hit tests to its parent while its child remains interactive.
avoid_when: Standard Stack and IgnorePointer or AbsorbPointer behaviors already meet your interaction needs.
strengths: Solves complex overlapping gesture routing problems easily.
Lightweight with no extra native dependencies.
weaknesses: Can make gesture debugging harder due to non-standard hit test behavior.
